title: BiometricSample
description: A biometric measurement captured from a person, such as a fingerprint image, iris scan, or facial photograph. Each record represents a single capture of a single biometric position (e.g., right index finger). A BiometricSample record may also document a capture exception: when exception_reason is non-null, the record explains why the biometric could not be captured rather than holding actual sample data.

person.description: A reference to the individual Person this record relates to.

biometric_modality.description: The type of biometric measurement (face, fingerprint, iris, signature, voice).

biometric_subtype.description: The specific body part or position within a biometric modality (e.g., right index finger, left eye, portrait).

impression_type.description: The method by which a fingerprint biometric was captured (e.g., live scan plain, rolled, latent).

capture_date.description: The date on which the biometric sample was captured.

quality_score.description: A quality score for the biometric sample, on a 0-100 scale per ISO 29794-1. Higher values indicate better quality.

quality_algorithm.description: The algorithm or standard used to compute the quality score (e.g., NFIQ2, ISO_29794_4).

sample_uri.description: A URI reference to the biometric sample data. The referenced resource contains the actual biometric data (image, audio, or other signal).

sample_format.description: The MIME type of the biometric sample data (e.g., image/jp2, image/jpeg, application/octet-stream).

exception_reason.description: The reason a biometric sample could not be captured. When non-null, this record documents a capture exception rather than holding biometric data.

capture_device.description: An identifier or description of the device used to capture the biometric sample.
